look: Crowned Geode Knight, a A-rank GKOM variant from the Geode Knights family: kingly armoured knight with a crystal crown, cape and great sword. Family anatomy: suits of plate armour with no body inside, filled and fused with geode crystal light. Build: compact and agile. GKOM rank cue: most of the body sheathed in GKOM crystal, natural surface only at the seams; the crystals are amethyst geode crystal. Element Light: warm gold, white and soft rose accents, vivid sweeping sun motes, feather-like light and halo rings
